Variants.Content: Shared hunting provided a less formal setting for nobles to talk. Horseback, woods, and risks could bring people closer and reveal their temperaments. Some people make allies at hunting feasts, others find them unreliable; the whereabouts of a deer are sometimes more meaningful than the wine glasses in the hall.
